summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of KasirCloud POS. Backend: 20/20 pytest tests passed covering auth, categories/products CRUD, inventory stock adjustments (Masuk/Keluar/Opname), full POS sale flow (stock decrement + invoice generation + change calc), refund (restores stock, marks refunded, prevents double refund), dashboard aggregations, sales reports, settings persistence, and RBAC (Kasir blocked from /users, /reports/sales, /products POST, /sales/{id}/refund; allowed on /dashboard, /products GET, /categories). Frontend: login as Owner works, dashboard loads with stats/7-day chart/top products/low stock/activities; POS full flow works end-to-end (search -> add-to-cart -> discount -> Tunai payment with cash input -> receipt shown with invoice INV-260801-0005, change, and stock decrement verified). Fixed a runtime bug (destroy is not a function) in Categories.jsx & Users.jsx (useEffect(load,[]) where load returned a promise).

ui_bugs.issue: useEffect(load, []) was passing a promise-returning function directly, causing runtime error 'destroy is not a function' on mount/unmount and blank overlay. FIXED by wrapping load in a void arrow function.
Recharts warns 'width(-1)/height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' - ResponsiveContainer parent has no fixed min-height in some viewport states (cosmetic; charts still render).
Missing DialogDescription and (for receipt) DialogTitle - Radix a11y warnings in console.

issues: Kasir role can still access /produk (and probably /kategori, /inventaris) by typing URL directly. Sidebar hides them correctly, but there is no route guard. Backend blocks mutations (POST/PUT/DELETE) with 403, so data is safe, but read-only page reveal is not ideal. Add a <RequireRole> wrapper per route.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py: JWT set with samesite='none' and secure=True is correct for cross-site cookies in prod, but requires HTTPS - fine here since REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is https.
server.py sale flow is not transactional: if stock update loop fails mid-way, partial stock decrements occur (no MongoDB session/transaction). Acceptable for MVP but worth noting.
server.py 'Penyesuaian' stock type behaves same as 'Masuk' (before + qty). If UX intent is 'set to qty', either merge with Opname or accept negative qty.
Owner refund does not restore Penyesuaian/Opname history entries (only reverses stock). Fine for MVP.
server.py has no rate limiting or brute-force lockout on /auth/login - flagged by playbook test hints but not required per spec.
Frontend AuthContext stores JWT in localStorage AND server sets httpOnly cookie - two auth channels; ensure logout clears both (server does delete_cookie, frontend should also remove pos_token).

rca of the issue: Bug: 'TypeError: destroy is not a function' on /kategori and /pengguna. RCA: `const load = () => api.get(...).then(...)` implicitly returns the Promise chain. Then `useEffect(load, [])` invokes load(), receives a Promise, and treats it as the cleanup callback. On unmount React tries `cleanup()` where cleanup is a Promise (non-callable) → 'destroy is not a function'. Fix: wrap the body in braces so useEffect callback returns undefined: `const load = () => { api.get(...).then(...); };`. Verified by re-navigating post-fix; no overlay/error.
